title: OpenCode: The Open Source AI Coding Agent for Your Terminal (and Desktop)
description:
OpenCode is the open source AI coding agent — an agent that lives right in your terminal and works on your codebase with you.

It ships with two built-in agents you can switch between with the Tab key: "build", the default full-access agent for development work, and "plan", a read-only agent for analysis and code exploration that denies file edits by default and asks permission before running bash commands — ideal for exploring unfamiliar codebases. There's also a "general" subagent for complex searches and multistep tasks, invokable with @general.

Installation is one command on basically any platform: a curl install script, npm, bun, pnpm, yarn, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman/AUR, mise, or Nix. And it's no longer terminal-only — a desktop app (currently in beta) is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Check out the repository here:
https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode
